chapter_note: Highly lacunose but consistently expository/cosmological with no dialogue frame, institutional material, or NT citation. The surviving phrases describe structural features of the Land of Light (five-fold elements, living ambrosia/air, aeons dwelling) in an impersonal teaching voice; final beatitude is also non-NT and functions as a sapiential closure rather than a Gospel citation.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Titular/incipit fragment naming the cosmic realm; no frame formula or citation markers.
